verdict.rationale: No evidence pack items mention telemetry, usage tracking, opt-out settings, or privacy controls of this kind; QuickBooks Online is a SaaS product where such a control could plausibly exist, so absence of evidence yields 'none' rather than 'na'. missing for 10: any privacy policy or settings documentation on telemetry/usage-data collection, any opt-out mechanism, any independent confirmation of such a control.
